description: The drawing consists of a single connected part. It is an open figure composed of four strokes: one curved arc and three straight lines. The curved arc, forming a semi-circle on the right, is textured with a chain of small circles. This arc connects to a straight zigzag line that runs roughly horizontally. From the left end of the zigzag line, a second straight zigzag line extends diagonally upwards and to the left, ending in an open point. From the right end of the horizontal zigzag line, a third straight line extends downwards and slightly left, then turns sharply right to form an acute angle; this final segment is textured with a chain of small triangles.
